newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via three-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via three-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system Monday through a round of three-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
The operation is seen coming at the Fed's usual 1130 EST/1630 GMT intervention period, unlike the past two sessions, when the Fed entered the market more than an hour early.
The Fed still faces an average daily add need of above $3.5 billion for the last three days of the current maintenance period, analysts predicted.
